# pumpfun-buy-decoder

> Version-tolerant pump.fun buy instruction decoder — 100% static, no CDN, no RPC.

- Site: https://visawestern.github.io/pumpfun-buy-decoder/
- Static demo, no backend. Open index.html in a browser.
